name: Cocoa
read: Cocoa Mar 27 options (on MAR 27 futures 5201, 85 days to expiry 2027-02-12): at-the-money implied vol 42.9%, -0.9 pts vs 2026-11-13. 20-day realized vol 39.9%, so options trade at a premium of 3.0 pts. 25-delta risk reversal +8.4 (calls over puts). Over the last 10 sessions (2026-11-06 to 2026-11-19) call open interest fell 64,540 and puts fell 34,861; put/call OI 0.47 → 0.42, front futures 5267 → 5201. Delta-weighted, option holders added about +1,871 futures-equivalent lots in the last 5 sessions (net long exposure bought through options). Front ATM vol 39.9% → 40.9%. Largest Mar 27 strikes: 6000 calls (5,728 lots) and 4500 puts (3,837). Biggest 5-session builds: Mar 27 6500 calls +1,291; Mar 27 5500 calls +1,063. Biggest cut: May 27 6000 calls -300.
